title: Hunza & Skardu Grand
summary: Nine days by road from Lahore up the Karakoram Highway: three nights in Hunza, then Skardu, its lakes and the Deosai plains.

image.alt: Turquoise Attabad Lake below a sunlit mountain, with boats and ferry pontoons at the jetty

overview.headline: Nine days up the Karakoram Highway to Hunza and Skardu
paragraphs: We drive up from Lahore on the motorway and the Karakoram Highway. Then we spend three nights in Hunza under Rakaposhi, and cross to Skardu for its lakes and the high Deosai plains.

This is a road trip at heart. The drive between stops is part of the trip: the Indus gorge, the place where three mountain ranges meet, the turquoise of Attabad. Your driver and guide set the pace, plan around the weather and know where to stop for chai.
suitedTo: First-time visitors who want Hunza and Skardu in one trip
Families with school-age children, and parents who like a planned pace
Couples and friends who would rather not drive the Karakoram Highway themselves
notSuitedTo: Travellers who dislike long road journeys. Days 2 and 9 are 11 hours or more
Anyone after a real trek (see the Fairy Meadows Trek)
Serious heart or breathing conditions at altitude. Check with your doctor first
Travellers who need luxury hotels every night; Chilas is simple
